p1.name: Flood Impact & WSS Damage
p1.method: P1 uses affected-population impact and, where PDNA data are available, water-supply-system impact. Within P1, affected-population impact contributes 40% and WSS impact contributes 60%.
p1.description: Affected-population impact (40%) plus PDNA WSS impact (60%) where current PDNA exists. WSS impact combines non-deduplicated beneficiary magnitude/share with physical damage D0–D5.

p2.name: Current WASH Conditions
p2.method: P2 is designed around water access and service continuity, water quality and safety, and sanitation and hygiene. Current PDNA data provide comparable municipality-level information for the first two. Sanitation and hygiene is not yet scored because comparable municipality-level data are not available. Where PDNA data exist, the water-access/service and water-quality/safety evidence is combined and adjusted by how much of the affected population is represented by assessed water systems. Where no current PDNA data exist, P2 is provisionally set to 2.5.
p2.description: Current WASH conditions from PDNA service status and water quality/public-health safety. Municipality evidence is moderated by an affected-population coverage proxy; no-PDNA municipalities retain provisional 2.5.

cautions: Physical damage is used in P1; service functionality is used in P2 to avoid double counting.
PDNA scheme beneficiary populations may overlap and are used as a scale/coverage proxy, not unique people.
PDNA reconstruction cost uses corrected w9.reconstructionCost (Excel column GR).
componentClassNote: Component/pillar classes use the established five-point component bands. Final severity uses absoluteClasses only.
